package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// PersonalTeacher stores the logical teacher identity and behavior settings.
type PersonalTeacher interface {
	Ensure(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, soul domain.TeacherSoul) (domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.TeacherSoul, error)
	GetByStudentID(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
	Update(ctx context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, expectedVersion int64) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
	GetSoulByStudentID(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
	UpdateSoul(ctx context.Context, soul domain.TeacherSoul, expectedVersion int64) (domain.TeacherSoul, error)
}
